Supports: Complete tubular animal with midbody widening; ventrally bent bulbous head with terminal mouth, pair head plates and pair anterior antenniform appendages; no evidence eyes. Six elongate paired setiferous anterior limbs without claws or obvious annulations, followed by nine stout annulated clawed limb pairs; backward-recurved claws and posterior trunk extension. Fifteen dorsal sclerite sets: first pair short spines, next14 sets each one long medial, paired medium dorsolateral and paired short lateral spines, tips curve anteriorly.
